[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/18575/diffs?diff_id=1221108070&start_sha=8b05721192717f6971125cee8fc2ecb3510e57e7)
changed title from **{-CM-}ake{-+tools-}: Add Stratoshark VCS version info** to **{+m+}ake{+-version.py+}: Add Stratoshark VCS version info**
This uses the Wireshark version information for now. Stratoshark-specific info will be added in another MR.

Since this was changed it looks like we don't enter here anymore, and by so never update the changelog date for Debian,

```
dpkg --contents wireshark_4.7.0_amd64.deb
drwxr-xr-x root/root         0 2016-10-17 12:05 ./
drwxr-xr-x root/root         0 2016-10-17 12:05 ./usr/
drwxr-xr-x root/root         0 2016-10-17 12:05 ./usr/bin/
-rwxr-xr-x root/root  11103728 2016-10-17 12:05 ./usr/bin/wireshark
```

+Tags for major Wireshark releases and release candidates consist of a “v” followed by a version number such as “v4.4.1” or “v4.4.3rc0”.

+Tags for major Stratoshark releases and release candidates consist of an “ssv” followed by a version number such as “ssv1.2.3” or “ssv1.3.4rc0”.
